blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong on Monday called on the Commission on Audit (COA) to audit government appropriations following the Supreme Court’s ruling declaring provisions of the 2024, 2025, and 2026 national budgets unconstitutional. Magalong also urged the Office of the Ombudsman to conduct an independent investigation to determine whether government officials should be held accountable under the law. In a statement, the mayor called for a special audit of the P449.5 billion in additional unprogrammed appropriations under the 2024 General Appropriations Act (GAA), the P17.99 billion added to the Special Road Fund under the 2025 GAA, and […]...
